content:
Last week's AirPods Pro 3 deal at nearly 25% off is still live and could end at any time; we also spotted the matte black Beats Solo Buds down to $41. But today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break headliner is Apple's official refurb store launching the cheapest M5 MacBook Pro with $300 off, alongside a $100 discount on a brand new Apple Watch Series 11, plus rare discounts on Apple Sport Bands and Loops. Then we're heading to Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand and 45W Nano smart display charger, both back at all-time lows, plus Best Buy's refreshed Back to School deals. All the details below.

Amazon's nearly 25%-off AirPods Pro 3 deal still live, may go up in price any moment

Last week's Apple Shopping Event featured one of the best AirPods Pro 3 deals we've ever seen. Best Buy's event and Pro 3 discount there are done, replaced by refreshed 2026 Back to School deals, but Amazon's nearly 25%-off AirPods Pro 3 discount is still on... for now.

Amazon is still shipping Apple's latest AirPods Pro 3 at $189.99 with free shipping.

Down from $249, this is nearly 25% off, approximately $10 below the July Black Friday deal, and one of the lowest prices we've tracked since launch.

Best Buy's price already bounced back to $200 this morning. Looking at recent history, this is usually Amazon's signal that the discount there could snap back at any moment — if you want one this week, now is the time to grab it. It also wouldn't be surprising at all if Amazon matched Best Buy's price back sometime this morning.

We've only seen it priced lower than this twice, both very brief drops — a $184 deal back in February and the more recent June Prime Day deal. Both of those are gone now, and we're unlikely to see a better price until the fall markdown season, at which point Apple may be releasing the next generation with potentially a camera and a higher price tag.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (List $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (List $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (List $129)
  • AirPods 4 ANC $119 (new original $179) – Renewed Premium

Apple's official refurb store launches cheapest M5 MacBook Pro with $300 off

While we're still seeing up to $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, the cheapest configurations of the M5 lineup have rarely seen any deals. But Apple's official refurb store is offering a $300 discount on the lowest-tier M5 MacBook Pro it still has in stock (16GB/1TB config), which is a compelling deal.

Apple's official certified refurb store is shipping the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB RAM and 1TB SSD for $1,699 with free shipping.

Originally $1,999, you can now grab one directly from Apple with a full 1-year Apple warranty and save $300.

For comparison, and further proving the point above, Amazon is currently selling this configuration brand new for $1,849. It's never been priced lower on Amazon since the official price hike went into effect late June.

Although it's refurbished, we're talking about the most reliable source for buying a refurbished MacBook from a reputable channel, and this is easily one of the cheapest M5 MacBook Pro models you can still grab brand new from Apple, the lowest-tier configuration.

Anker's new 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand returns to Prime Day low (35% off)

I tried this model when it debuted earlier this year, and Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a staple in my EDC, travel setup, and home charging station. Now at nearly 35% off, we have a chance to grab it at the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon.

Anker's official Amazon store is now shipping the latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 with free shipping.

This charging station normally goes for $150, features a 3-in-1 design with the MagSafe pad delivering up to 25W output, and is now nearly 35% off in both Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White colorways.

This week's deal matches what we featured before, hitting the same price points as the Anker summer sale and this year's Prime Day.

Although it's about the size of your palm for portability, it has some weight to it that lets it stay put on your desk or nightstand, working just as well at home as it does on the go.

You can use the main MagSafe charging pad while it's folded shut, but flip it open and you'll find a pop-out Apple Watch charger and a Qi pad for AirPods, letting you charge your entire device setup at once.

  • 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger with 25W Qi2
  • Active cooling "Cicada wing" biomimetic airflow channels for an ultra-quiet 19 dB operation
  • 25W total output across iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods
  • Qi2 certified with MagSafe magnetic alignment • Supports iPhone 17, 16, 15, and 14 series
  • iPhone: Up to 25W wireless charging
  • Dimensions (3.74 × 2.38 × 1.22-in), weighs the same as an iPhone 17 Pro Max (8.11 oz)
  • In the box: Anker Prime wireless charging station (3-in-1, MagGo, AirCool, foldable), 45W USB-C charger, 5-foot USB-C to USB-C cable, 2 anti-slip Apple Watch stickers, welcome guide, 24-month warranty

Learn more in our hands-on review.

Cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 models back down to $299 with $100 off

Amazon has extended its AirPods Pro 3 summer pricing into August alongside AirTag 2 at all-time lows, and is once again discounting most of the most popular (and cheapest) Apple Watch Series 11 models with $100 off, starting at $299.

Amazon is once again taking $100 off all base GPS-only Apple Watch Series 11 models, with the 42mm going for $299 and the 46mm down at $329.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (List $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (List $429)

These match the summer Prime Day deals we tracked before, having surfaced several times in July, and they're back again today. At the time of writing, only the base GPS-only models are seeing notable discounts — GPS + Cellular variants do have some deals, but most aren't quite low enough to make them worth picking up.

It looks like the base 42mm Jet Black is currently out of stock at Amazon, but there's a good chance it'll be restocked soon — all 46mm color options are in stock and $100 off.

Rare Apple Sport Band and Loop discounts take 20% off at Amazon this week

Grab a pair of matte black Beats Solo Buds today, down to $41

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter works in "200+ countries," now $20
  • Belkin's new UltraCharge 2-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger rarely discounted to $54 (all colors)
  • Sharge Mini portable power bank with orbital LED lights now $35 (List $50)
  • This DOCKCASE SSD enclosure displays drive health and features power-loss protection, now $30 (all-time low)
  • Don't pay Apple's premium — grab LG's UltraFine 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor while it's $2,200 less than Studio Display XDR (new low)
  • Nothing Headphone (a) discounted again: $159+ in all colors, more options from $69
  • Nothing debuts CMF Clip Pro open earbuds at $79 with new launch deal
  • Beats' new 240W braided USB-C cable (black) is back to $18 Prime shipped all-time low (40% off)
  • Anker 7-in-1 smart display Nano charging station with retractable USB-C now $60

Best Buy rolls updated 2026 Back to School deals: sub-$500 TVs, Bose $130 off, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen, more

Anker's 2026 Back to School sale drops chargers, power banks, and Qi2.2 gear to Prime Day lows from $10 (46% off)

Anker is now running a sitewide Back to School sale with promo code SCHOOL20 for 20% off everything, spanning chargers, power banks, cables, charging stations, and more. The brand's official Amazon storefront has also matched many of the deals, with extra discounts on several models. The sale covers everything from compact Nano chargers to multi-port laptop bricks, MagSafe charging gear, power banks, and other everyday accessories. Many of Amazon's deals have dropped prices back to match recent Prime Day all-time lows, letting you grab them at the best prices ever without waiting for the next big sales event. If you're gearing up for a new school or work setup, or just looking to refresh your charging arsenal, there are several Anker deals worth a look right now.

Anker 2026 Back to School sale officially kicks off

The brand's official Amazon storefront has added a few new deals, which we've flagged below alongside some existing offers for you to check out.

  • Anker 45W Nano charger with smart display $26 (List $40)
  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (List $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging station with display $135 (List $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch controls $116 (List $150)
  • Anker 140W 4-port laptop charger with display $65 (List $90)
  • Anker 25,000mAh 165W laptop power bank with dual USB-C cables $105 (List $120)
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 docking station with detachable 6-in-1 hub $112 (List $150)
  • Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 charging station $72 (List $90)
  • Anker Nano slim 5,000mAh MagSafe power bank $44 (List $55)
  • Promo code: SCHOOL20
  • And more...

One standout deal in this markdown is Anker's latest 45W Nano USB-C charger with a smart display, down to $25.99 with free shipping. Normally $40, today's deal knocks $16 off, matching the all-time low from the recent Prime Day sale. That's 35% off, beating the deal you'd get buying directly from Anker. This is one of Anker's newer compact chargers, and all colorways are at the low $25.99 price. The built-in smart display can identify supported iPhone models to optimize charging for safer power delivery and display useful charging info alongside a few fun animations. The single USB-C port delivers up to 45W output, while foldable prongs keep the whole thing compact and travel-friendly for tech bags or everyday carry.
